text_block_list.text:
I spotted Air Groove looking rather 
downcast...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, why didn't I realize it at the very 
beginning...
choice_data_list: Did you mess up or something?
Did you make a mistake or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, I've made a terrible blunder...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"During lunchtime today, the President 
kept repeatedly jumping into the 
conversation with 'Indeed, like soda.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Though I suspected it might be some kind 
of pun, I didn't understand it at the 
time...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The President made a pun on the carbonated 
water I was drinking, saying, "Soda-n!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To think the answer was in my hands from 
the very beginning... Gah!

Whatever the reason was, she seemed very 
down in the dumps...
